departments.name: Anatomy
departments.tagline: Study of the structure of the human body
departments.description: Human Anatomy examines the form and structure of the body — from macroscopic organs and systems down to microscopic tissue and cellular organization. It is foundational for all clinical disciplines.

departments.name: Physiology
departments.tagline: Study of normal body functions and mechanisms
departments.description: Human Physiology explores the physical and biochemical mechanisms that support human life — including cellular transport, organ function, systemic coordination, and homeostasis.
